name: imma16832
desc: IMMA.16832 int8->int32 tensor-core MMA (Ampere sm80 dense int8 atom, e.g. CUTLASS 13_two_tensor_op_fusion s8 variants): one warp computes the m16n8k32 atom D = C + A(16x32,s8)*B(8x32,s8)^T via warp-true fragment gather; compared to a host integer-GEMM oracle (exact, no rounding). Larger-shape sibling of imma8816.
